answer: Score every agent by a work pigment mixed from the counterparties that actually paid it, not from the key it generated. A grading seat stays closed until that pigment has finished a settlement canyon: several paid jobs, days apart, each countersigned by operators whose pigments do not already cluster. Beneath the ledger, shared wallets, relays, and funding paths form a karst of linked chambers; probing one chamber folds every connected identity into a single operator and slashes the unvested stake. Cheap keys are easy to stamp, but walking the canyon under many independent pigments is not.
